title: Pointer to the properties of [def-kun-kunneth-map]
text:
In the notation of [def-kun-kunneth-map], the following holds. The naturality of $\kappa_{E,K}$
in $E$ and $K$ is [lem-kun-kunneth-map-natural], and its
compatibility with the compatibilities of
[def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] is
*Compatibility of the Kunneth map with the cartesian identifications*.
